selection: Transformer checkpoint 37 selected on 2021 frozen-ensemble AUC within matched 39-epoch budget, then fixed 37 epochs for 2022. Transformer 50/50 old/new component mean was selected on 2021 before 2022. Combined variant also applies the independently 2021-selected Haukeli 50/50 old/new component mean, with 121 specialist trees fixed for 2022. All plant weights remain frozen.
uncertainty: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap of daily case starts, preserving all 2352 outputs per sampled case. 120 draws per 7/14/28-day block length, seed4173. Conditional percentile intervals do not correct repeated model selection; positive draw fractions are not p-values.
validation_caveat: 2021 and 2022 are heavily reused development years. Jan7+ removes six 2022 starts overlapping 2021 selection horizons, without creating an independent holdout. Cached baseline components have their original early-stopping histories. No competition labels used.
slice_note: Subset AUC is descriptive only; incident pair errors are measured against available positive-negative pairs. Group incident counts overlap. Negative incident_error_delta_in_global_pair_units is beneficial.

transition_regions.definition: Within +/-2 hours of true-label state change, centered at first new-state hour; diagnosis only.

conclusion.assessment: The frozen combination of the two separately preselected component means is a stronger candidate than either alone under these reused development comparisons.
conclusion.2021: AUC +0.000251413; all three conditional block intervals positive. Incremental Haukeli gain over transformer mean alone is only +0.000009968, with all intervals crossing zero.
conclusion.2022: AUC +0.000378109; Jan7+ +0.000378636. All 7/14/28-day conditional intervals are positive in both views. Incremental Haukeli gain over transformer mean is +0.000184205, also positive across all three full-year intervals.
conclusion.slices: 2022 within-month AUC improves 11/12 months (April -0.000357). Incident ranking errors touching month slices improve 11/12 (July slightly worse). These are different quantities and need not agree. Near-transition AUC improves +0.000866; away improves +0.000262.
conclusion.limitations: No evidence here guarantees a public/private Kaggle gain. Reused years, selected checkpoints, original baseline stopping and circular-block assumptions remain. Do not switch to full replacement or retune weights based on 2022.
